neighbours.label: a modifier saying how long something lasts (overnight, multi-day, two-week)
fire: We booked an overnight bus from the capital to the coast.
The scouts prepared for a three-day hike in the hills.
Climbers set out on a multi-week expedition to the glacier.
The conference is held over a five-day period every spring.
She signed up for a ten-day retreat in the desert.
He went on an overnight camping trip with his sons.
The crew began a two-week voyage around the cape.
The clinic treats most of them on a same-day basis.
quiet: We booked an afternoon bus from the capital to the coast.
The scouts prepared for a difficult hike in the hills.
Climbers set out on a dangerous expedition to the glacier.
The conference is held at a lakeside hotel every spring.
She signed up for a yoga retreat in the desert.
He went on a fishing trip with his sons.
The crew began a stormy voyage around the cape.
The clinic treats most of them on a sliding-fee basis.

notes: 'Side effects' and 'suspended animation' also fire the pole, and this test does not cover them. Near misses put a non-duration modifier in the same slot.
